definitions.explanation: A tall tower built so that visitors can enjoy a wide view of the surrounding scenery.

examples.japanese: {展望塔|てんぼうとう}に{登|のぼ}る。
{展望塔|てんぼうとう}から{町|まち}が{一望|いちぼう}できる。
examples.english: You can see the whole town from the observation tower.

examples.japanese: {公園|こうえん}の{展望塔|てんぼうとう}に{登|のぼ}ると、{遠|とお}くに{海|うみ}が{見|み}えた。
examples.english: When we climbed the observation tower in the park, we could see the sea in the distance.

notes:
A tower built for taking in scenery. Built from {展望|てんぼう} (a view; outlook) and {塔|とう} (tower).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {展望塔|てんぼうとう}に{登|のぼ}る: to climb an observation tower
- {展望塔|てんぼうとう}からの{眺|なが}め: the view from the observation tower

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {展望台|てんぼうだい}: observation deck; viewing platform — a platform rather than a freestanding tower
- {灯台|とうだい}: lighthouse — built to guide ships, not for sightseeing
